content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined charcoal wool skirt suit, tailored with a structured blazer jacket and matching high-waisted trousers in a matte finish, color #36454F, fabric: heavy wool blend. A crisp white silk blouse with a modest neckline, cut classic and slightly loose for comfort during long services, color #FFFFFF, fabric: smooth silk chiffon. Simple silver stud earrings and a delicate silver chain necklace, as requested, metal: sterling silver with an oxidized finish to honor the somber occasion. Black leather loafers with a slight heel, chosen for practicality on potentially damp autumn ground, color #000000, fabric: smooth calfskin leather. This outfit honors the solemnity of your grandfather's funeral by adhering strictly to your request for silver jewelry and avoiding any lightness numbers or measurements, offering a respectful, neat silhouette that transitions seamlessly from the morning service to any subsequent family gatherings, while the dark wool provides appropriate dignity for an autumn Thursday in Ukraine."}
